items.text: Amoionit Yosua kokokosanite noi; kotema EJAKAIT ŋes atiar, “Imojoŋit ijo ikokosanit da noi, konye ideuna akwap naepol nakiruma.
Na ŋes akwap naeroko ideuna: akwap kere naka Ipilisitian ka Igesurin kere;

Ageun koSikor, loejai kinaren naka Misiri, kiton oikor loka Ekuron kari naka agolitomei, loemarakinitai oKanaanin: ijaka ikany luka Ipilisitian; Igasin, ka Isudodain, ka Isikelonain, ka Igitin, ka Iyekuronin; luka Abim da,
Kari naka eŋalakimak: akwap kere naka Ikanaanin, ka Meara loerai loka Isidonin, kiton Apek, kiton oikor loka Imorain:
Akwap da naka Igebalin, ka Lebanon kere, kama eniunia akoloŋ, ageun koBaal-gad kwap kemoru Kerumon kiton neelomarere Kamat:

Luibojete kere kakwap nakiukon ageun koLebanon kiton Misirepot-maim, kes Isidonin kere; ereŋeari eoŋ ŋul kakonyen nuka idwe luka Isirael: konye kokorak ijo idwe luka Isirael akwap nin araun airumet, kwape keeorakinia joo
Aso kokorak akwap na araun airumet naka atekerin akanykaoŋon, ka atutubet naka ateker naka Manase.”
Apotu Ireubenin ka Igadin kodumut airumetekee nepepe kaŋes, naabu Musa koinak kes kokekwa loka Yorodan kari nakokide, kwape ainakinia Musa ekejaanakinan loka EJAKAIT kes;
Ageun koAroer, loejai osiep loka aditot naka Arunon, ka ere loejai kidin aditot, ka apuuton kere naka Medeba kiton Dibon;
ka ireria kere luka Sikon ekabaka loka Imorain, loayait Kesibon, kiton oikor loka idwe luka Amon;
ka Gilead, ka eikor loka Igesurin ka Imaakatin, ka moru Kerumon kere, ka Basan kere kiton Saleea;
Ajakanut kere naka Og koBasan, loayait Asitarot ka Ederei (nopenol Ioedeuna loka luedeuna luka Irepaim); naarai abu Musa kodany ŋul, kireŋea da,
Konye mam idwe luka Isirael apotu kireneasi Igesurin, karaida Imaakatin: konye apotu Gesur ka Maakat kiboikinos kidin kIsirael, kiton lolo,
Ateker naka Lebi bon ŋes mam ŋes abu koinak airumet; ainakineta nueinakinere kakim nuka EJAKAIT Edeke loka Isirael, kes airumeteke, kwape abu kolimokinia Ŋes.
Koinak Musa ateker naka idwe luka Reuben kwape ejaatar ikekiakec,
Ageunit eikorukec koAroer, loejai osiep loka aditot naka Arunon, ka ere loejai kidin aditot, ka apuuton kere naka Medeba;
Kesibon, ka ireriake kere lueiaas apuuton; Dibon, ka Bamot-baal, ka Bet-baal-meon;
Ka Yakas, ka Kedemot, ka Mepaat;
ka Kiriataim ka Sibima, ka Seret-sakar komoru loka aditot;
ka Bet-peor, ka neijululuoro Pisiga, ka Bet-yesimot;

ka ireria kere luka apuuton, ka ajakanut kere naka Sikon, ekabaka loka Imorain, loayait Kesibon, loabu Musa kodany nepepe kiiaka luka Midian, Ebi, ka Rekem, ka Sur, ka Kur, ka Reba, ikapolok luka Sikon, lueboiete kakwap.
Apotu idwe luka Isirael koarata Balaam da okoku loka Beor, ekadwaran, kotoma kanul luaponi koarai.
Arai Yorodan eikor loka idwe luka Reuben, ka eikoruke. Ŋin ŋes airumet naka idwe luka Reuben kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, ireriakec lukapolok ka ludidik da.
Koinak Musa ateker naka Gad, kes idwe lukaGad, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee.
Arai Yaser eikorukee, ka ireria kere luka Gilead, ka atutubet naka akwap naka idwe luka Amon, kiton Aroerloitei Raba;
Ageun koKesibon kiton Ramat-misipe, ka Betonim; ageun da koMakanaim kiton oikor loka Debir;

Kaditot da, Bet-karam, ka Bet-nimura, ka Sukot, ka Sapon, ka ajakanut kere naedeuna naka Sikon ekabaka loka Kesibon, Yorodan ka eikoruke, kiton osaŋe loka aŋolol naka Kinerot, okekwa loka Yorodan kokide.
Ŋin ŋes airumet naka idwe luka Gad kwape ejaatar ikekiakec, ireriakec lukapolok ka ludidik.
Koinak Musa atutubet naka ateker naka Manase airumet: arai naka atutubet naka ateker naka Manase kwape ejaatar ikekiakec.
Ageunit eikorukee koMakanaim, Basan kere, ajakanut kere naka Og ekabaka loka Basan, ka ireria kere luka Yair, luejaas Basan, ireria akaisakanykape:
ka atutubet naka Gilead, ka Asitarot, ka Edcrei, ireria luka ajakanut naka Og koBasan, araas luka idwe luka Makir okoku loka Manese, kes atutubet naka idwe luka Makir kwape ejaatar ikekiakec,
Ŋun kes airumeta nuakorokoroi Musa kapuutona nuka Moab kokekwa loka Yorodan koYeriko, kokide.
Konye mam Musa abu koinak ateker naka Lebi airumet: EJAKAIT, Edeke loka Isirael, ŋes airumetekec, kwape abu kolimokinia kes.
